answer: The hollow graph is validated at intake and the terrace frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and nectar anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 9 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 2489 account sybil into a 20 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
